code:
Database Engine service   MSSQLSERVER / MSSQL$Instance
Agent service              SQLSERVERAGENT / SQLAgent$Instance

Agent stopped  ->  Engine keeps answering queries
Agent runs the scheduled and event-driven work:
backups, index maintenance, ETL, custom T-SQL.
caption: Agent is independent of the Database Engine — and can silently be down while queries still work.
